description: Generic concept → theme pipeline for a Game Kit project: the saved art direction (gripforge_game_art_direction: look, theme, palette, notes, device) becomes ONE interface concept image (title, main menu, HUD with health, a weapon card, key prompts), a vision pass reads its design tokens (colour roles, radius, border width, button shape, padding, letter case, weight, the closest open-licence font, glyph style, closest preset) and they are written as the ui.theme config (contrast repaired). The concept is kept in the Library (kind concept, category ui). action=quote prices it: 1 credit per run (quote it and ask the user before run). Without regenerate the latest concept of the project is reused with the tokens already read from it (0 credits), so a run after a dry run applies exactly what the dry run showed; reread=true reads the concept again (1 credit). dry_run=true writes nothing. run returns a generation job: poll it with gripforge_generation_read; its result carries config, tokens, fixes, previous_config and revision_before for a rollback (gripforge_gamekit_configure ui.theme with previous_config).

action.description: quote prices it and returns next; run queues it (needs expected_revision from quote).

dry_run.description: true: generate and read the tokens without writing the project.

expected_revision.description: run: the revision returned by quote.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

regenerate.description: true draws a new concept image; default reuses the latest concept of the project.

reread.description: true runs the vision pass again on the reused concept (1 credit) instead of its saved tokens.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_game_theme_from_concept
title: Fill the game interface theme from a generated UI concept
